---
title: CLI Help
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
  comment: ""
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-cli-help
#| include: false
yamark_bin <- Sys.getenv("YAMARK_BIN", unset = "")
if (!nzchar(yamark_bin)) {
  status <- system2(
    "cargo",
    c("build", "--release", "--manifest-path", "../Cargo.toml")
  )
  if (!identical(status, 0L)) {
    stop("`cargo build` failed with status ", status, call. = FALSE)
  }

  yamark_exe <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "yamark.exe" else "yamark"
  yamark_bin <- normalizePath(
    file.path("..", "target", "release", yamark_exe),
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = TRUE
  )
}

yamark_help <- function(...) {
  args <- c(..., "--help")

  output <- system2(
    yamark_bin,
    args,
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE,
    env = c("NO_COLOR=", "CLICOLOR_FORCE=1")
  )
  status <- attr(output, "status")

  if (!is.null(status)) {
    stop(
      "`", yamark_bin, " ", paste(args, collapse = " "), "` failed with status ", status,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  output <- sub("[ \t]+$", "", output, perl = TRUE)
  output <- htmltools::htmlEscape(output)
  output <- fansi::sgr_to_html(output, term.cap = "256")
  knitr::asis_output(paste0(
    "<pre class=\"yamark-cli-help\"><code>",
    paste(output, collapse = "\n"),
    "</code></pre>\n"
  ))
}
```

These captures come from the Yamark binary built from this repository. Start
with [Usage](usage.qmd) for common commands; use [Reference](reference.qmd) for
configuration, directives, and supported syntax.

## `yamark`

```{r}
#| label: help-yamark
#| results: asis
yamark_help()
```

## `yamark format`

```{r}
#| label: help-yamark-format
#| results: asis
yamark_help("format")
```

## `yamark git-filter`

```{r}
#| label: help-yamark-git-filter
#| results: asis
yamark_help("git-filter")
```
